description: Vedic architectural system emphasizing strict alignment to cosmic coordinates, exact mathematical proportions (Ayadi formulas), and the purifying influence of the rising sun.
schools_note: MSV is uncompromising regarding cardinal orientation; homes rotated even slightly off true north-south are considered non-compliant.

rules.rationale: Sunrise in the exact East provides the foundational nourishing pranic energy; South entrances bring destructive cosmic influences.
rules.source: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi, 'Celebrating Perfection in Building' (1998), pp. 45-52

rules.rationale: The Brahmastan is the holiest center of unbounded silence and consciousness, crowned by a natural roof lantern (Brahmasthan kalash).
rules.source: Maharishi Vastu Architecture Institute Design Manual, Sec. 3.2

rules.rationale: South-East is the Agni sector; cooking here promotes vitality and flawless digestion.
rules.source: Maharishi Sthapatya Veda Architecture Guidelines, Ch. 4

rules.rationale: South-West coordinates provide profound deep sleep, emotional balance, and parental authority.
rules.source: Maharishi Sthapatya Veda Architecture Guidelines, Ch. 4

rules.rationale: North-East is Ishanya; unobstructed early sunlight aids meditation, intellectual clarity, and spiritual progress.
rules.source: Maharishi Vastu Architecture Institute Design Manual, Sec. 5.1

rules.rationale: Dining should be immediately adjacent to the kitchen, facing East while eating.
rules.source: Maharishi Vastu Architecture Institute Design Manual, Sec. 5.4

rules.rationale: North is ruled by Mercury/Buddha, facilitating analytical intellect, accounting, and scholarly focus.
rules.source: Maharishi Sthapatya Veda Architecture Guidelines, Ch. 5

rules.rationale: Drainage must flow towards the North and East, with waste fixtures isolated in the Northwest.
rules.source: Maharishi Vastu Technical Notes on Drainage and Waste (2004)

rules.rationale: Staircases represent movement and mass, placed along perimeter walls to shield the south/west sun.
rules.source: Maharishi Sthapatya Veda Architecture Guidelines, Ch. 6

rules.rationale: The highest architectural elevation and heaviest mass must occupy the South-West.
rules.source: Maharishi Vastu Technical Guidelines on Structural Massing
